name: aigloo
description: Self-hosted AI gateway. Route, translate and track requests across providers, with access keys, budgets, and a built-in dashboard.
author: xk1ko <221650117+xk1ko@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm --prefix dashboard run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.cpSync('dashboard/.next/static','dashboard/.next/standalone/.next/static',{recursive:true});fs.rmSync('dashboard/.next/standalone/src',{recursive:true,force:true});(function rm(dir){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(dir,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())rm(f);else if(e.name.endsWith('.map')||e.name.endsWith('.d.ts'))fs.rmSync(f)}})('dist')"
